acceptance: Red test first: --writable go exits with the usage code and starts no seat.
A --writable that names a file that does not exist yet still passes (a new file).
The cli-contract of agent run states the rule in STE.
fix: In the writable check, refuse with exitUsage a path that is an existing directory in the worktree, and name the rule (one file for each --writable).
source: console, 2026-11-03: --writable agents --writable go ... passed the start checks; the fence then reverted every file the builder wrote
summary: The usage says that a writer needs one --writable PATH for each file that it can change (go/internal/cli/agentcmd/agent.go:36). The start check in go/internal/cli/agentcmd/profiles.go:79 accepts any clean path inside the worktree, so a directory passes. The fence then treats each file under it as out of scope and reverts it after the run.
title: evolve agent run refuses a --writable that names a directory before it starts the seat
